async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Use the search box to filter projects by name 'metaseq'
    search_box = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await search_box.fill('metaseq')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 2: Wait for the search results to load and click the 'metaseq' project link
    # Assuming the project appears as a link with name containing 'metaseq'
    metaseq_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='metaseq', exact=False)
    await metaseq_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 3: Click on the 'Issues' link to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 4: Click the 'New issue' button
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role('link', name='New issue')
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Step 5: Fill in the issue title and description
    title_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title')
    await title_input.fill('Plan for supporting Llama and other llama family models in metaseq')
    description_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description')
    await description_input.fill('I would like to inquire about the plan to support Llama and other models in the llama family within metaseq. Could you provide details on any ongoing or planned efforts?')
    # Step 6: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Submit issue')
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
